name: loopcard
description: Create and manage LoopCard decks and generate structured English word cards from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Create decks and structured word cards.
interface.longDescription: List, inspect, and create user-owned LoopCard decks and cards, with a dedicated Skill contract for high-quality English vocabulary cards.
defaultPrompt: Create a new deck and add cards to it.
Show the cards in one of my decks.
Generate a precise English word card with canonical parts of speech and IPA.
